reuse.why: Reuses getApproxNumberThreshold and getRangedAmount, but introduces getExpectedAmount next to the existing getScheduledAmount instead of making that helper the single entry point.

duplication.why: Removes the five inline dispatches, but getScheduledAmount keeps its own null/number/range dispatch alongside getExpectedAmount's, so the dispatch now exists twice.

placement.why: The rule sits in shared/schedules.ts with the other schedule amount helpers; the tolerance comes from shared/rules.ts.

scope.why: Only the expected-amount sites, the helpers, a test, and an optional _amountOp field on the forecast raw type.

maintainability.why: Two overlapping public helpers with a trailing optional op; desktop-client callers of getScheduledAmount pass no op and so silently miss the approximate rule.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Server sites call the shared helper; nothing goes around it.

disguised_duplication.where: getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts keeps the missing/number/range dispatch that getExpectedAmount also performs, reshaped (number branch delegates, range branch still calls getRangedAmount itself).

one_place.where: The approximate rule is in getExpectedAmount (shared/schedules.ts) but only applies when op is passed; getScheduledAmount's desktop-client callers (Balance.tsx, SchedulesTable.tsx, MobileSchedulesPage.tsx, SchedulesListItem.tsx, useScheduleEdit.ts) pass none, so those paths do not apply it.
